title: 第六章 心中大惊，却不敢相信！
novel_title: 全民原始部落，你搞军事基地？
content_zh:
此刻，在秦天的领地边缘，出现了一个身穿重甲，手持剑盾的人。

    他的目光警惕扫视着四周，神情紧绷。

    他叫孔梁，属于他的领地，就在这不远处。

    和大部分玩家的慌乱不一样，他在被拉进来，并且觉醒自己的天赋以后，就开始步步为营，开始着手发展领地。

    并且发展的还相当顺利！

    因为他觉醒的是A级天赋，荒野猎人！

    顾名思义，此天赋可以让他觉醒狩猎相关的技能，可以说是先天克制那些野兽！

    所以他跟世界频道那些鬼哭狼嚎的玩家，还是有着本质的区别的，那些人为了一点儿吃的，求爷爷告奶奶的，他就不一样。

    他把自己的领民全都安排去开采物资，至于自己？则是亲自出发，开始狩猎！

    好在他领地附近的野兽还是有不少，他每次出行，都能有不少收获。

    获取的肉类自然也是远超其余的玩家，不仅能让自己的领民吃饱，甚至还有一定程度的富余，可以拿出来进行售卖。

    这也让他获得了一些额外的收益。

    在他原本的计划中，照这样发展下去，要不了多少时间，自己就可以将领地升级！

    后来世界上有相应的公告，已经有其他玩家对领地进行过升级，这让他很意外。

    看那些在世界频道发言的家伙， A级天赋是极为稀少的。

    而他也确实发展的很好。

    居然还能有人比他快这么大一截？莫非是S级天赋？

    这也只是他的猜测罢了。

    后来，公告里出现有领主击杀凶兽的事情，让他尤为在意。

    现在这个阶段，能成功击杀凶兽的，必然是少之又少！

    而这正好跟他专业对口啊！

    在他想来，如果成功击杀，应该是可以得到不菲的奖励。

    所以这一次他就靠着自己被强化的猎人嗅觉，尝试着寻找自己的领地附近是否有凶兽的存在。

    如果有的话，他也想要尝试加以狩猎！

    只是，令他有些不悦的是，那只凶兽不知是不是感知到他在后面进行追捕，居然在尝试拉开和他之间的距离。

    甚至，还跑出了他的领地范围！

    不过，出于对自身的实力的信任，他并不在意这些。
content_en:
At this moment, at the edge of Qin Tian's territory, a man wearing heavy armor and holding a sword and shield appeared.

    His eyes scanned the surroundings with vigilance, his expression tense.

    His name is Kong Liang, and his territory is not far away.

    Unlike the panic of most players, after he was brought in and awakened his talent, he started to develop his territory step by step.

    And it’s developing quite smoothly!

    Because he awakened an A-level talent, Revenant Hunter!

    As the name suggests, this talent allows him to awaken hunting-related skills, which can be said to be an innate ability to restrain those beasts!

    Therefore, there is a fundamental difference between him and those players on the World Channel who cry like ghosts and howls like wolves and wolves. He is different from those people who beg their grandfather and sue their grandmother for a little food.

    He arranged for all his subjects to mine materials, but as for himself? Then set off in person and start hunting!

    Fortunately, there are still many wild animals near his territory, and he can gain a lot every time he travels.

    Naturally, the meat obtained far exceeds that of other players. Not only can his subjects be fed, but there is even a certain degree of surplus that can be sold.

    This also allowed him to gain some additional benefits.

    In his original plan, if things continued like this, he would be able to upgrade his territory in a short time!

    Later, there was a corresponding announcement in the world, and other players had already upgraded the territory, which surprised him.

    Looking at the guys who spoke on the World Channel, A-level talents are extremely rare.

    And he did develop very well.

    How could anyone be so much faster than him? Could it be an S-level talent?

    This is just his guess.

    Later, there was an announcement about a lord killing a ferocious beast, which made him particularly concerned.

    At this stage, there must be very few people who can successfully kill the ferocious beast!

    And this coincides with his professional counterpart!

    In his opinion, if he successfully kills him, he should be able to get a lot of rewards.

    So this time he relied on his enhanced hunter's sense of smell to try to find out whether there were ferocious beasts near his territory.

    If there were, he'd want to try hunting them too!

    However, what made him a little dissatisfied was that the ferocious beast didn't know if it sensed that he was chasing him from behind, and it was actually trying to distance itself from him.

    He even ran out of his territory!

    However, out of trust in his own strength, he didn't care about this.
title_en: Chapter 6 I was shocked, but I couldn’t believe it!
